protocol_metadata.about: Sky (formerly MakerDAO) is a collateral-backed stablecoin protocol on Ethereum that allows users to mint USDS by depositing crypto collateral into Collateralized Debt Positions (CDPs), or earn yield by depositing USDS into the Sky Savings Rate (SSR) module to receive sUSDS. The protocol also supports SKY governance token staking via the LockStake Engine for rewards. Sky is built on the long-running MCD (Multi-Collateral Dai) core — the Vat, Vow, Jug, and Pot system — rebranded from MakerDAO in 2024–2025 and extended with new components including USDS, sUSDS, stUSDS, LitePSM, and the Allocator system.
